reason: Even with restricted Google Drive permissions, letting any third-party tool connect to our client repository is too much of a confidentiality risk for sensitive ITR and ROC records. Furthermore, as a two-person practice with rotating article trainees, training them on new software is a waste of time when our manual folders suffice.
objection: Granting third-party OAuth access to our firm's Google Drive creates an unacceptable risk of client data exposure or accidental corruption during peer reviews.
would_change_my_mind: A verifiable zero-access security audit ensuring no external token access to file contents, coupled with an interface so effortless that fresh trainees require zero training.
